replacement.title: Green-Background and No-Green-Background PNG Variants
replacement.definition: Deliver the referenced completed illustration as two PNG variants, one with a green background and one without a green background.

patches.decision_note: The requested background variants are independently deliverable assets and do not belong to the base illustration or general file-format Requirement.
The source reports only PNG review files and explicitly says final files remain pending, so it does not claim completion of the PNG-and-JPG delivery Requirement.

These messages identify illustrations through attachment-dependent phrases such as 'this design' or 'this one'; the omitted visual attachments prevent safe confirmation of their current core-illustration routing.

The generic 'changes done' claim may resolve to several immediately preceding illustration revisions, but the supplied evidence cannot safely establish whether it supports the two current claims, all three core illustrations, or a narrower subset.
The include-smoke update depends on the omitted proposal in message 64, while the visibility update may only repeat the cropping failure already recorded at message 63.
